# Vidya and Co.(Chartered Accountants)

Vidya and Co.(Chartered Accountants) is a Financial Services company. The company provides services in audit and assurance, foreign companies and nri consultancy, tax consulting, management consultancy, legal consulting, accounting and payroll processing. They have a pan-India presence with branches in Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Delhi, and Mumbai. They have a pan-India presence with branches in Ahmedabad, Delhi, and Mumbai. Vidya and Co.(Chartered Accountants) employs 9 people (+5.9% YoY, +1 person), founded in 1977. Headquartered in India, with presence in United States.

## About

M/s. Vidya & Company, a firm of Chartered Accountants, was formed as a Partnership concern on 26th May,1977 with Mr. Rajendra Jha & Mr. Sarad Jha being pioneer partners of the firm. 
Today it is a one stop shop for accounting and financial services with Pan India presence. It has offices in Kolkata, Mumbai, Delhi, Ahmedabad and Bhopal.
A highly skilled and experienced team of nine partners and more than thirty staff provide well thought and well researched opinions. We have served various industries, including public and private sector companies. 
We are rated as Category 1 since 2008 by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India.
